motivation: The corrected dense-fewer gap decreased from 0.011118 at 50% backward activity to 0.006034 at 75%; this is one predeclared near-dense development point, not a fresh-body confirmation or a post-win replication

execution.forward: ordinary dense FFN for every token
execution.backward: custom gathered active-row-only FFN dgrad and wgrad at 87.5% activity; inactive FFN-path input gradients exactly zero; residual gradients intact
execution.deployment: ordinary dense inference without masks or custom execution

full_cost_accounting.auxiliary_operations: realized scoring and gather/scatter estimates added separately
full_cost_accounting.evaluation: retained separately from training cost for every arm

dense_fewer_quality_reference: results-program/level3-75/body6/dense-fewer_seed9406.json; quality only, with CPU-calibrated dense cost
primary_endpoint: ordinary dense held-out loss of low_max_abs_update versus random_update and dense-fewer at matched full training cost
exact_cost_rule: use the lower of the two final costs; keep the lower-cost arm at its final evaluation and linearly interpolate the other arm between its bracketing evaluations; also report both unadjusted final endpoints

decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs_update beats random_update but not dense-fewer; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs_update beats random_update and dense-fewer at exact matched cost
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: changing the custom backward, activity, steps, or evaluation after launch
using MPS-only totals as full costs
presenting this development operating-point search as independent confirmation
launching body 7 without a development-level dense-fewer win
